en: A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing the passenger steamship S/S BRYNHILD cruising on calm water. Smoke is rising from the central funnel marked with a large letter "S". Lifeboats line the upper decks, and several passengers are visible on board. Trees and shoreline appear faintly in the background under a partly cloudy sky. Caption text is printed along the bottom border.
